subject: Quantiva: request for commercial carveouts (MFN / benchmark / discount) — exec guidance needed
messages:
From: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-04-11T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Quantiva: request for commercial carveouts (MFN / benchmark / discount) — exec guidance needed

Team — forwarding a time-sensitive request from Quantiva (attached redlines). Key asks from the customer: 1) 35% upfront commercial discount; 2) MFN carveout for 12 months that disallows Redwood from offering any better publicly-available rate to other named competitors; 3) a benchmark exclusion — they ask that we do not include Quantiva in any competitive public benchmark comparisons; and 4) a short-term regional exclusivity clause limited to analytics use-cases in NA for 12 months.

We discussed flexibility on pricing but the MFN + benchmark + exclusivity together are high-risk. I need an executive steer: approve as-is (fast close), approve with constraints (finance/legal-prescribed limits), or push back and offer counter-proposal. Quantiva says procurement needs a signed agreement by end of next week to meet their internal board cycles.

Attachments: TermSheet_Quantiva_redlines.docx, MAP_Quantiva.xlsx, Quantiva_SOW_v3.pdf

Quick asks:
- Karthik/legal: high-level risk and acceptable carveouts?
- Ben/finance: maximum discount we can tolerate with this customer profile and what we need in commitment/CLAWBACK?
- Lauren/revops: are there product/metrics reasons to avoid benchmark carveout?

If we can get a decision within 48 hours I can accelerate counter-offer + DocuSign.

Thanks — Priya
Priya Natarajan
Senior Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
pri...@redwood.com

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-04-11T11:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quantiva: request for commercial carveouts (MFN / benchmark / discount) — exec guidance needed

Priya — quick legal assessment:
- MFN: full MFN that bars us from offering better publicly-available rates to "named competitors" is unacceptable. It ties pricing across accounts and can constrain promotions/partner pricing. If we consider MFN, it must be narrowly scoped (e.g., list price only), exclude time-limited promotions, and have a finite duration (12 months max). Also require carveouts for channel/partner-discounting.
- Benchmark exclusion: reasonable to accept a public-facing conditional (Quantiva not to be included in marketing/competitive benchmark materials) but we must retain the right to run anonymous, internal benchmarks and aggregate cohort-level reporting. Absolute prohibition on any benchmarking hampers internal ops/metrics and reporting to prospects.
- Exclusivity: complete exclusivity in a vertical is high-risk and likely rejectable. We can offer "preferred partner" language or a narrow restriction tied to a defined product + geography + time window, with revenue milestones and a clawback if they underdeliver.

I can draft narrow contract language if we land on commercial parameters. Recommend finance/revops provide target discount cap and commit length.

-Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Head of Deal Desk & Legal Ops | Redwood Inference

From: Elena Soto <elena.soto@quantiva.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.com>
Cc: Michael Jenner <michael.jenner@qcounsel.com>
Date: 2028-04-12T08:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quantiva: request for commercial carveouts (MFN / benchmark / discount) — exec guidance needed

Priya — appreciate the fast turnaround. A few clarifications from our side:
1) The 35% discount is tied to our FY28 procurement budget — if we don’t secure this we will not be able to proceed this quarter.
2) The MFN language we need is to ensure we are not displaced by competitive pricing during our initial roll-out. We are not asking Redwood to forgo promotions entirely, but we need protection that a named commercial competitor (X-Analytics, Proxima Labs) cannot be offered a lower list price for like-for-like terms.
3) We will not agree to be used in public-facing competitive materials without our prior approval; that includes comparative benchmark charts. We are comfortable with anonymized internal benchmarking and aggregate studies.

We can be flexible on exclusivity — our ask was simply to ensure a 12-month window that prevents direct vendor marketing to our core analytics teams during the pilot phase. We have procurement counsel on copy. We need confirmation in writing by 2028-04-18 to hit our board review.

- Elena Soto
Head of Procurement | Quantiva Health

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-04-13T09:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quantiva: request for commercial carveouts (MFN / benchmark / discount) — exec guidance needed

Financial view: 35% upfront on list is aggressive for a first-year enterprise deal unless we get strong commitment/guarantees. Options that preserve unit economics:
- Option A (preferred): 20% initial discount + usage-tiered rebate (up to additional 10%) tied to 12-month revenue thresholds; require 18-month minimum term and minimum committed ARR of $180k.
- Option B: 25% initial discount limited to first 6 months, then revert to net rates; require a 24-month term and a 12-month minimum revenue guarantee.

Any approval should include a clawback if they terminate early and a stipulation that the MFN, if granted, exclude channel/partner pricing and short-term promotional campaigns.

Attached: Pricing_Schedule_RevA.xlsx (pro forma scenarios).

-Ben

From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-04-14T14:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quantiva: request for commercial carveouts (MFN / benchmark / discount) — exec guidance needed

Thanks for the assessments. Executive decision and conditions below:
1) Approve a one-time concession to accelerate deal close: authorize a maximum 25% initial discount (not 35%), on the condition we implement a performance/usage rebate structure that recoups up to an additional 5–10% tied to 12-month adoption milestones (use Ben's Option A as basis).
2) MFN: allow a narrowly scoped MFN limited to published list price for the exact SKU(s) and term (12 months), explicitly excluding channel/partner discounts and time-limited promotional credits. MFN must expire automatically at 12 months. No retroactive price adjustments.
3) Benchmark exclusion: we will agree to publicly exclude Quantiva from competitive marketing/benchmark materials without prior written consent. We will retain the right to anonymize Quantiva in internal benchmarks and aggregate public studies (i.e., "Customer X").
4) Exclusivity: reject broad exclusivity. Offer a "preferred partner" designation that includes a mutual non-solicit of vendor outreach to specified analytics teams for 12 months; acceptance contingent on revenue thresholds.

Final caveats: Legal (Karthik) to draft narrow contract language including a clawback provision if thresholds not met; Revenue Ops (Lauren) to confirm metrics we can measure and commit to; Finance (Ben) to confirm deal economics under these terms. Once legal/redlines are ready, Priya to push DocuSign to Quantiva.

Markus
Markus Klein
Chief Revenue Officer | Redwood Inference

From: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.com>
To: Elena Soto <elena.soto@quantiva.com>, Michael Jenner <michael.jenner@qcounsel.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-04-18T16:48:00-07:00
Subject: Quantiva — conditional approval & next steps (DocuSign link included)

Elena / Michael — thank you for the quick collaboration. Per our internal review we can move forward on conditional terms. High-level summary (please review):
- Commercial: Redwood will offer a 25% initial discount with a usage-tiered rebate program (up to an additional 5–10% based on 12-month adoption milestones). We will include an 18-month minimum term and a minimum committed ARR of $180k (see attached Pricing_Schedule_RevA.xlsx).
- MFN: Limited MFN for 12 months, scoped to the specific SKUs in the Term Sheet and limited to list price only. The MFN will explicitly exclude channel/partner discounts, short-term promotions, and marketplace/partner program pricing.
- Benchmark clause: Redwood will not include Quantiva in any public-facing comparative benchmark or marketing materials without prior written consent. Redwood reserves the right to anonymize Quantiva in aggregate/anonymous benchmarks for internal and aggregate public studies.
- Exclusivity: We cannot agree to broad exclusivity. Instead we will include a "preferred partner" clause restricting direct vendor marketing to the named analytics team for 12 months, conditional on revenue thresholds and a mutual non-solicit.

Next steps:
1) Karthik will circulate narrow legal language (TermSheet redline) today.
2) When redlines are accepted, I will send the DocuSign package for signature: https://www.docusign.com/sign/quantiva-qntv-2028
3) Please have counsel (Michael) confirm the MFN carveout language and benchmark clause within 48 hours so we can meet Quantiva's board timeline.

Attachments: TermSheet_Quantiva_redlines.docx, MAP_Quantiva.xlsx, Pricing_Schedule_RevA.xlsx
HubSpot record: https://app.hubspot.com/records/QNTV-12345

Looking forward to closing — Priya
